description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Lock & Latch Complete Repair Kit.
Contains the Exact Types & Quantities of Clips to Completely Replace the Drivers Door, Passengers Door and Tailgate Locks & Latches Clips.
Contains ALL THREE Lock Cylinder Installation Clips.
Contains Door/Tailgate Latch & Striker Plate Screws
These are the original clips with Snap-In & Lock Down Features.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 3 – Lock Cylinder Rod Clips
Qty 4 – Latch Rod Clips
Qty 2 – Exterior Door Handle Rod Inserts
Qty 3 – Lock Cylinder Installation Clips
Qty 6 – Door/Tailgate Striker Plate Screws
Qty 3 – Tailgate Latch Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
